SELECT 'monthly_revenue' AS view_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count 
FROM vw_monthly_revenue

UNION ALL

SELECT 'cbd_impact', COUNT(*) 
FROM vw_cbd_impact

UNION ALL

SELECT 'zone_demand', COUNT(*) 
FROM vw_zone_demand

UNION ALL

SELECT 'hourly_patterns', COUNT(*) 
FROM vw_hourly_patterns

UNION ALL

SELECT 'dropoff_demand', COUNT(*) 
FROM vw_dropoff_demand
